messages:
Rafael M: Heads-up HorizonGrid PO HG-PO-2026-2337 stuck in procurement. They redlined SLA uptime, demanded PO-only, and want Net-120 payment terms. Need quick sync.

Aisha B: Noted. Legal flagged the SLA changes (they convert service-level credits into a termination right) and PO-only eliminates our MSA protections.

Clara T: Marketing has the joint case study planned next week; they said they'll delay launch if tile isn't live. Can finance accept Net-120 temporarily?

Ben G: Finance no on Net-120 for new partners. Could accept Net-30 if they provide an ACH or card or we set a 30% prepay. Also VAT: they want us to absorb VAT in EU — that's not standard.

Rafael M: Customer insists on PO-only for internal vendor onboarding. They claim Legal cannot sign our addendum. Any stopgap? Conditional PO or contract appendix?

Aisha B: We can offer a 1-page contract appendix referenced by PO that preserves IP, limits liability to 12-month fees, and converts SLA credits to remediation rather than termination. Add a 25% holdback until appendix signed.

Clara T: HorizonGrid procurement said they'd accept a referenced appendix and holdback if Legal-to-Legal confirms the language. That would keep the launch moving.

ProcureBot: PO HG-PO-2026-2337 status updated to "Under Review" by Aisha B at 2026-06-07 14:23 UTC.

Ben G: If they insist we absorb EU VAT, we need a tax form or reverse-charge evidence. Otherwise pass-through VAT is required. Rafael, can you request their VAT registration and payment preference?

Rafael M: On it. I'll push for conditional PO referencing the appendix, 25% holdback, Net-30, and confirm VAT reverse-charge. If they refuse the reverse-charge, escalate to Partnerships lead.

Aisha B: I'll draft the 1-page appendix now and post in the deal folder. TL;DR: keep platform IP, 12-month liability cap, SLA remediation language, 25% holdback release on executed appendix + acceptance tests.

Clara T: Thanks  If procurement signs conditional PO today we can proceed with the case study timeline. Please paste any replies here so Legal can review quickly.

Ben G: Finance also needs the invoice milestone schedule before we can provision Net-30. Rafael, please add milestones to the PO or send separately.

Rafael M: Will share milestones in 10m. Marking this high priority. If no conditional PO + appendix by EOD, escalate to VP Partnerships. :pray:
